text: Hello there! Cycling is a great way to exercise, and it's so much fun to explore new routes and discover different towns. Helmets are essential to keep your body safe and your head protected from the sun. Gears are used to change the direction of your bike and make it turn smoothly. But, do you know that there is another important tool in the bike world? It's called a chain. Chains are metal bands that connect the spokes of your bike to the wheels. They keep your bike moving smoothly and evenly. So, keep riding and explore the world around you with your bike!
